# MICHELIN Guide

> > The official MICHELIN Guide featuring restaurant ratings, star awards ceremonies, and culinary festivals across Abu Dhabi and global destinations.

The MICHELIN Guide is the renowned international restaurant rating system established by the Michelin brothers, featuring the prestigious star rating system. The site covers MICHELIN-starred restaurants, annual awards ceremonies, food festivals, and culinary events, with particular focus on Abu Dhabi's growing gastronomic scene in partnership with the Department of Culture and Tourism.

## Key Topics

- MICHELIN Stars
- Abu Dhabi
- Restaurant Awards
- MICHELIN Guide Ceremony
- Food Festival
- Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental
- MICHELIN-starred restaurants
- International chefs
- Gastronomy
- Chef masterclasses
- Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi (DCT)
- Culinary events
- Star rating system
- Invitation-only ceremonies

- [About Us](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/about-us): History of MICHELIN Guide from Michelin brothers to star rating system

## MICHELIN Guide Ceremonies

- [MICHELIN Guide Ceremony Abu Dhabi 2026](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/event/michelin-guide-ceremony-abu-dhabi-2026): 2026 awards ceremony at Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu Dhabi
- [MICHELIN Guide Ceremony Abu Dhabi 2025](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/event/michelin-guide-ceremony-abu-dhabi-2025): 2025 star awards ceremony featuring chef Debi Prasad Rath at Emirates
- [MICHELIN Guide Ceremony Abu Dhabi 2024](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/event/michelin-guide-ceremony-abu-dhabi-2024): 2024 awards ceremony at Louvre Abu Dhabi Park with chef Lee Kok Hua

## Food Festivals & Culinary Events

- [MICHELIN Guide Food Festival Abu Dhabi 2025](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/event/michelin-guide-food-festival-abu-dhabi-2025): Third annual Food Festival at Emirates Palace, Nov 21-23, 2025
- [MICHELIN Guide Food Festival Abu Dhabi 2024](https://guide.michelin.com/ae-az/en/event/michelin-guide-food-festival-abu-dhabi-2024): 2024 Food Festival at Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Nov 22-24
